climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
building_stock: Both Tarneit Airtasker task pages describe front doors that are not pre-prepared for smart hardware, so a Tarneit install reads as a cut-and-drill job rather than a swap into an existing mortice: one brief is "Complete installation of entry set (pull handles and roller latch) at the front door" where "The task include drilling and installing the 2 pull handles (both sides of the door) as well as drilling/cutting and installing the roller latch" (airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/tarneit-vic), and another is "I need someone to make a hole and install an Aqara A100 smart doorlock" (airtasker.com/au/services/locksmith/tarneit-vic). Direct Locksmiths' Tarneit page adds the detached-dwelling secondary access points that a Tarneit job has to reconcile — "Deadlocks, deadbolts, sliding door locks, gate locks" and "locks and latches for gates, sheds, external doors and garages" (directlocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-tarneit). No returned record mentioned apartment or common-entry doors, heritage timber doors, or double-glazed sliders in Tarneit, and the Airtasker Tarneit page cross-links only to Thornhill Park and Weir Views.
council_notes: None identified — no returned record referenced a heritage overlay, a body-corporate or owners-corporation rule, or a rental-provider obligation for Tarneit. The only regulatory-adjacent framing in the set is commercial rather than residential: apmlocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-tarneit offers "commercial-grade locks, access systems, and master key setups for offices, retail stores, and industrial spaces". Nothing in the signals shows a common-property or heritage door constraint to work around here.
demographic_skew: The returned records evidence buying behaviour rather than resident demographics, and it skews self-directed and quote-comparing: a Tarneit resident had already purchased the specific unit and wanted only the door cut for it ("I need someone to make a hole and install an Aqara A100 smart doorlock", airtasker.com/au/services/locksmith/tarneit-vic), and oneflare.com.au/locksmith/vic/tarneit publishes a suburb-specific price band — "between $98-$180, with the median price of Locksmith in Tarneit being $120" — so this audience arrives with a number in hand. Sentry Locksmiths' Tarneit page addresses "the owners and lessees of commercial, industrial and residential property", i.e. both tenures, though that is the same Melbourne-wide sentence it runs on its other suburb pages, so it should not be read as a Tarneit tenure signal. No age, family-stage, or short-stay/Airbnb signal appears in any returned record.
common_concerns: Whether the installer will actually cut and drill the door, because Tarneit briefs are cutting jobs rather than swaps — "I need someone to make a hole and install an Aqara A100 smart doorlock" (airtasker.com/au/services/locksmith/tarneit-vic), and an entry-set install needing "drilling and installing the 2 pull handles (both sides of the door) as well as drilling/cutting and installing the roller latch" (airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/tarneit-vic).

Whether a locksmith will fit a smart lock the resident has already bought rather than only hardware the locksmith supplies — the Tarneit Airtasker request names the unit the customer already owns, an "Aqara A100 smart doorlock", and asks only for the hole and the fitting.

What it should cost, measured against a published local figure — oneflare.com.au/locksmith/vic/tarneit states Tarneit locksmith work runs "between $98-$180, with the median price of Locksmith in Tarneit being $120", so a Tarneit quote gets benchmarked against that number.

Whether the locksmith who turns up is genuinely local to Tarneit — every provider in the result set is a Melbourne-wide mobile operator running a Tarneit landing page (sentrylocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-melbourne/tarneit, citywestlocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-tarneit, directlocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-tarneit, apmlocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-tarneit), and the one Tarneit smart-lock page in the set asks readers to "call us at 03 6163 7474" (toplocksmithmelbourne.com.au/tarneit/smart-lock-repair-tarneit-vic) — an 03 61xx prefix sits in the Tasmanian numbering range, not Melbourne's 03 8xxx/9xxx — so evidence of real local attendance is worth stating plainly.
